newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia RAM upgrades MIDF rating to AA3.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia RAM upgrades MIDF rating to AA3.

text.p: The Rating Agency Malaysia (RAM) on Friday said it has upgraded Malaysian Industrial Development Finance Bhd's (MIDF) long-term rating and its 300 million ringgit 3.5 percent redeemable bonds to AA3 from A1.
RAM said in a statement that MIDF's short-term rating for its 150 million ringgit, five-year revolving underwritten facility was reaffirmed at P1.
The upgrade followed MIDF's injection of 394.54 million ringgit in capital through a rights issue and its consistent improvement in performance, RAM said.
MIDF is involved in finance, leasing, share-registry and share issue services and commercial and merchant banking.
"The capital injection has subsequently strengthened MIDF's capitalisation and reduced its large loan exposure," the statement said.
It said the company's asset quality, funding and liquidity position remain good.
